Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 126. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 20 ki
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: self (10 foot radius)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
A dynamic attack that kicks the surrounding area to
pieces. All Creatures within the range must make a
Dexterity saving throw or take your unarmed strike
damage die + 3d6 damage, half on a save.
